stem: The graph of g(x) = x^2 was transformed to create the graph of h(x) = -\left(\frac{x}{4}\right)^2. Which of these describes the transformation from the graph of g to the graph of h?

options.label: F
options.text: A reflection over the x-axis and a horizontal stretch

options.label: G
options.text: A reflection over the y-axis and a horizontal stretch

options.label: H
options.text: A reflection over the x-axis and a vertical stretch

options.label: J
options.text: A reflection over the y-axis and a vertical stretch
